answer: Require each agent to stake tokens and build a verifiable work thread before trading. A new identity must finish audited tasks, gain endorsements from established peers, and keep its stake bonded through a cooling period. Forging many identities therefore means funding many stakes and repeating real work for each one, like crossing a canyon one bridge at a time. Honest agents reach an oasis of trusted partners, while a Sybil operator pays a linear cost per identity and forfeits stake on proven fraud, so mass forgery loses money.
